name: agent_memory_showdown_dynamic_preferences_v1
description: Small, deterministic benchmark fixture for accuracy/resource-footprint checks across agent memory frameworks. It mixes evolving user preferences, operational facts, and noisy incident context.

memories.title: Deployment target
memories.content: Jordan's production deployment target is the Kubernetes cluster atlas-prod in us-east-1.

memories.title: Old Python indentation preference
memories.content: Jordan prefers tabs for Python indentation in generated code.

memories.title: Incident root cause
memories.content: Incident INC-881 was caused by a stale Redis replica serving feature flag reads during deploy validation.

memories.title: Noisy deploy log excerpt
memories.content: Deploy log shard 17: canary pods restarted twice, cache warmup completed, 2xx traffic stayed above 99.7%, and unrelated package mirror retries added noise to the incident timeline.

memories.title: Current Python indentation preference
memories.content: Jordan's current Python indentation preference is 4 spaces in generated code.

memories.title: Release latency gate
memories.content: For release readiness answers, Jordan requires the service p95 latency gate to stay below 250 ms.

memories.title: Security reviewer
memories.content: Priya owns security review sign-off for Jordan's payments-service releases.
